title: Mushroom Goddess of Cosmos
description: A vibrant surreal painting of a female figure with green hair and orange-red skin merging with a massive mushroom. The mushroom cap features a stained-glass mosaic pattern containing a swirling galaxy, set against a colorful cosmic sky with stars and aurora-like gradients.
prompt: A surreal female figure with orange skin and long flowing green hair adorned with pink flowers, merging into the stem of an enormous mushroom. The mushroom cap is a colorful stained glass mosaic depicting a spiral galaxy. She holds glowing orbs containing tiny figures. The background is a vibrant cosmic sky with stars, nebulae, and rainbow gradients over dark mountains. Lush grass and smaller glowing mushrooms surround the base with roots spreading into the ground.
